keyring.description: Path to the OpenPGP keyring file containing trusted certificates.

required_signatures.description: The number of valid signatures to return success. Counts certificates, not raw signatures.

signature_file.description: Path to the detached signature file.

data_file.description: Path to the data file to be verified.

not_after.description: Consider signatures created after this ISO 8601 timestamp as invalid. Empty for no constraint.

not_before.description: Consider signatures created before this ISO 8601 timestamp as invalid. Empty for no constraint.
